# Lulu

> Lulu is a free, open source (MIT) macOS app from Falcao SL. It is a native Swift app that manages local inference engines and MLX and GGUF models, starts an OpenAI-compatible API on that Mac, and shows memory and speed when the engine reports them. The Apple Silicon download for v2.0.21 is 3.1 MB. Release packages are signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

## Pages

- [English](https://lulu.falcaosl.com/): product page, downloads and FAQ

- [Privacidade](https://lulu.falcaosl.com/privacy.pt.html): the same page in Brazilian Portuguese
- [Releases](https://github.com/Falcao-SL/Lulu/releases): macOS installers
- [License](https://github.com/Falcao-SL/Lulu/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT

## Facts

- Publisher: Falcao SL (https://falcaosl.com/#org). Contact: dev@falcaosl.com.
- Price: free. License: MIT. No account and no in-app purchase.
- Platforms: macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon runs MLX and GGUF. Intel Macs use GGUF with llama.cpp.
- Built-in engines: mlx-lm, mlx-vlm and llama.cpp. llama.cpp installs through Homebrew. MLX installs through uv. Lulu does not install Homebrew or uv.
- The engine catalog can install and open Ollama, LM Studio, Jan and GPT4All. Each of those apps keeps its own models and server.
- Clients Lulu can configure: OpenCode, Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Aider, Zed, Antigravity, OpenClaude and DeepSeek. mlx-lm does not serve /v1/responses or /v1/messages.
- Lulu opens a local web chat and provides model and server controls from the macOS menu bar. It does not train models.
- The local server listens on this Mac only. The default endpoint is http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.
- Inference stays on the Mac. Searching and downloading models, and installing engines, use the network. There is no analytics SDK and no crash reporter. Update checks run when the user asks.
- Current downloads are listed in https://lulu.falcaosl.com/release.json and are replaced when a GitHub Release is published.
- v2.0.21 Apple Silicon DMG: 3,125,176 bytes (3.1 MB). Intel DMG: 3,170,406 bytes (3.2 MB). On one Apple M4 with 24 GB, measured 16 Nov 2026, Lulu.app was 6.5 MB on disk and the idle physical footprint was 66 MB with no model loaded. Those figures do not include engines or models, and they were not compared with other apps on that machine.
